card.name: Word-start "re" before a continuation
card.fires_on: The short word-start piece "re" or "Re" (also "RE" and "pe") at the start of a longer word, such as revised, reevaluated, reprinted, REACTION or Reclamation. It fires when the rest of the word is still to come.

modes.label: re- before a verb
modes.description: The piece "re" begins a verb or participle like reevaluated, reprinted or re-examined.
modes.example: the patient should be<< re>>evaluated (see PRECAUTIONS

modes.label: RE in capitalised words
modes.description: Capitalised "RE" or "Re" begins a word such as REACTION, Reynoldsburg or Reclamation.
modes.example: IF AN ALLERGIC<< RE>>ACTION TO CEFPROZIL OCC

card.writes: It seems to suppress continuations that spell "rad" and to favour radio or meteor-like continuations, so the effect is weak and unclear.
card.plain: It marks the start of a word that begins with "re" and is still unfinished.
